description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine -  Order under section 3 of the State Industrial Corporation Act No. 49 of 1957
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an Order under Section 3 of The State Industrial Corporation Act, No. 49 of 1957 that repeals and substitutes the First Schedule of a previous Order. While it mentions Minister Rajitha Senaratne, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to make regulatory changes, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
